notes.title: Patch Notes - Quality of Life + Backend Prep!
notes.notes:
Patch Update - UI Fixes & Multiplayer Prep!

[hr][/hr]

🛠️ What's New

 
Fixed UI Text Position – Cleaned up layout issues for better visual consistency.
'Exit Dungeon' Button Added – You can now exit dungeons via the Pause Menu (press ESC).
Dungeon Event Instruction Fixes – Event instructions now trigger and display correctly.
New Audio Cues & SFXs – Some new sounds have been added to spice up gameplay. More will be added with each update.
Multiplayer Prep (Backend Only) – We've laid down the foundation for multiplayer. This is backend only for now, so no changes are visible just yet.


[hr][/hr]

🔮 Coming Soon

 
More audio SFXs
Combat camera shake for a more dynamic feel
Multiplayer mode support will be enabled


[hr][/hr]

Thanks for the support!
Keep sending feedback and stay tuned for more updates. 👀

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3.6
notes.notes:
🥩 Patch Notes 0.3.6 – Chef’s Special & Safe Haven Tweaks! 🔪

Another round of fixes is hot off the grill! Here’s what’s changed:

🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements

🔥 Chef's Dash & Skewer Adjustments – Fixed an issue where the Chef's Dash (Right Click) and Skewer (E) would overshoot if the mouse hadn’t been moved recently. No more surprise wall-hugs!

👀 Chef Facing Fix – The Chef now faces the correct direction when using Dash and Skewer. No 
more awkward backward lunges.

🏰 Safe Haven Teleporters Updated – As a temporary fix, the two teleporters on Floor 5 have been moved and labeled to make choices clearer when players reach the Safe Haven.

🗨️ Dialogue Improvements – Tweaked various dialogue lines for better clarity. No more cryptic NPC mumblings!

As always, keep the feedback coming! Your reports help us keep the dungeon running smoothly (or at least intentionally chaotic). See you in the next run!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3.5
notes.notes:
⚔️ Patch Notes 0.3.5 – Fine-Tuning the Chaos! ⚔️

Adventurers, we’ve got some crucial fixes to make your dungeon delves smoother (and slightly less cursed). Here’s what’s changed:

🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements

🗡️ Warrior’s attack hitbox adjusted – Now properly matches animations for more precise combat! No more phantom swings.
🏷️ Seed Display Enabled – You can now see the generated level seed in the bottom-left corner. This should help track down those tricky dungeon bugs!
📜 Event Room Instructions Restored – Turns out they went poof by accident. They’re back now, so no more wandering around clueless!

Thanks for your continued support! Keep slashing, looting, and reporting those bugs. See you in the dungeon!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.4 - Warrior Fixes & Combat Adjustments
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 0.3.4 - Warrior Fixes & Combat Adjustments


 Fixed an issue where the Warrior could get completely locked out of all input commands.
 Fixed an issue where the Warrior could get stuck in a permanent movement or sliding animation.
 Fixed an issue where the Warrior could not attack but could still use other abilities.
 Corrected an error where the Warrior's Bash ability caused issues when used on destructible objects.

Ultimate Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the Warrior's ultimate skill required only 1 ult charge instead of 5, now matching other characters.
 Fixed an issue where the Warrior, Chef, and Barbarian incorrectly gained ult charge from destructible objects. Ult charge can now only be gained in combat with monsters.


Thanks for playing! Keep the feedback coming, and we’ll continue improving the demo! ⚔️🔥

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.3 - Stability Fixes
notes.notes:
**Patch Notes 0.3.3 - Demo Update**  

  
 Fixed a critical issue where dying in a dungeon run prevented proper death handling in consecutive runs within the same session.  
 Added a demo version number to the main menu screen.  
  

Enjoy the latest fixes, and let us know if you encounter any issues! 🚀

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Updates 07/19/2024
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,

We have some exciting updates and bug fixes for you! Our team has been working hard to improve your gaming experience. Here's what's new:

[hr][/hr]

Fixed Bugs


Relics and Inventory

 Fixed a bug where equipping a Relic and then clicking the sort button would duplicate the item but prevent players from equipping or swapping Relics.
 Added missing Relics to the Relic Unlock Screen.
 All Relics now display their health effects correctly in the Character UI.

    Character Abilities

 Player stuck in place after using the Ultimate ability with the Archer/Barbarian/Warrior has been fixed.
 The Archer no longer slides across the ground if hit while using skills.


    Character Stats UI
 
 The Character Stats UI now shows the current player health correctly, especially if the player is injured.

[hr][/hr]

Known Bugs

Multiplayer

 Players switch Characters when loading into the Dungeon.
 When all players are downed/zero HP, they are not teleported out of the Dungeon.

Diner Section

 Taking out ingredients for cooking during the diner session causes the sprites to appear solid black while the player is holding them. This is just a visual bug.
 Separating ingredients from incomplete plated dishes can delete the currently held ingredient if the player keeps interacting with the plated dish.
  Customers heading towards the middle table sometimes get stuck but can be moved back into place if the player bumps into them.


[hr][/hr]


Improvements

Inventory

     The default inventory limit has been increased by one row.


[hr][/hr]

Work In-Progress

We are starting to implement the level up system, as currently, players cannot level up or gain EXP. This improvement is aimed at enhancing your gameplay experience.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We appreciate your patience as we work to make the game better with each update.

Happy Adventuring!
